THING_MODEL.SPECIFICATIONS:
RFID Reader
Features:
  • Registration Server compatible 
  • Conditions can be set for a valid or invalid card
Usage:
  • Read the ID of an RFID Card
  • Transmit that ID to the registration server
Direct Control:
  • N/A
Local Control:
  • N/A
Remote Control:
  • N/A
Data Specifications:
  • Message Format: [Card Id],[status]
    Card Id: A positive number greater than 0
    status: 0 - V    alid; 1 -  Invalid; 2 - Waiting
Example:
  • Create an RFID Reader.
  • Create one or more RFID Cards.
  • Assign an ID to each card.
  • Set up the registration server and conditions.
  • Once set up move the RFID cards to the card reader and it will send the ID to the registration server.
  • See the RFID_Reader.pkt sample file.
